xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5604: Dashboard shows a 'waiting on you' toast for an already-answered question on page load (stale snapshot cache), and never closes a toast when its question closes

plan.title: Dashboard shows a 'waiting on you' toast for an already-answered question on page load (stale snapshot cache), and never closes a toast when its question closes
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On page load the dashboard renders the localStorage snapshot cache before /ws/rpc bootstraps. The cache is saved only on full snapshots, so it can hold an agent question answered long ago; usePendingInputDialogs announces every agent pending input in the store (toast + desktop notification) and the same arrays open the AskUserQuestion/PlanApproval modals. Separately, showPendingInputNotification keeps no toast id or Notification handle, so a toast never closes when its question closes.
narratives.Proposal: Add a tiny gate store (lib/agentPendingInputGate.ts) whose `held` field is a frozen copy of the agent pending-input lists or null. It starts held with empty lists, so the snapshot cache never shows. EventRouter bootstrap() holds it immediately before syncSnapshot(snapshot) and settles it only after the post-snapshot replay has applied (no replay needed or 'caught-up') and the bootstrap generation is current; holding an already-held gate keeps the earlier copy, so a reconnect shows the pre-reconnect lists until the new data has caught up. A new useLivePendingAgentInputs hook returns `held ?? live lists`, gating toast, desktop notification, modals and reconcile in one place; conversation pending input (live HTTP poll) stays ungated. showPendingInputNotification keys toasts by tag and keeps desktop notifications in a module map; dismissPendingInputNotification(tag) closes both. The announce effect is extracted into usePendingInputAnnouncements and dismisses keys that leave the live set; usePermissionNotifications dismisses a cleared prompt's key and both reminder keys. Docs and changelog record the behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Refreshing the snapshot cache on applied events
- Hiding cached Needs-you rows or other cached UI during the cached phase
- Dismissing a toast on the optimistic dashboard answer (it closes when the server clears the question)
- Changing useDesktopActivityNotifications' cached-backlog priming
- Changing re-announcement after the conversation pending-input poll returns [] on a non-OK response
- Gating conversation pending input
- Gating lib/refresh-dashboard-state.ts (live snapshot written outside bootstrap after merge/close-out)
- Recovering the pre-existing frozen store after a 'failed' post-snapshot replay
- Any server, contract or /ws/rpc change
- Gating on streamLive (it flips false on every reconnect)

autoDecisions.summary: Gate on a hold/settle bracket around bootstrap's snapshot and post-snapshot replay (lib/agentPendingInputGate.ts), not on streamLive and not on a one-way latch
autoDecisions.rationale: Plan critique: a latch set by setStreamLive(true) opened before the post-snapshot replay applied deferred clearing events, on first load and on every reconnect. streamLive flips false on every blip and would dismiss and re-announce live toasts.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate the agent source arrays so the AUQ/plan modals are gated too, not only the announce loop
autoDecisions.rationale: The modals read the same arrays and the UI store is not persisted, so a fresh load would open a modal for the same stale question; one gate at the source fixes both.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not gate conversation pending input
autoDecisions.rationale: It comes from a live 4 s HTTP poll with no React Query persister, so it is never stale cache.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep desktop Notification handles in a module-level map keyed by tag with dismissPendingInputNotification(tag)
autoDecisions.rationale: Simplest caller API; both announce paths already pass a unique tag; entries are removed on dismiss, click and onclose.

autoDecisions.summary: Cover permission-prompt notifications, including both reminder tags
autoDecisions.rationale: They share showPendingInputNotification and have the same never-closes defect.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract the announce effect into usePendingInputAnnouncements
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes the cache-to-live transition testable with renderHook and real stores without mounting the React Query-heavy dialog hook, and shrinks a 673-line file.

autoDecisions.summary: A toast closes when the server clears the question, not on the optimistic answer
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's fix; sonner already closes a toast when its Answer action is clicked.

autoDecisions.summary: While held, show the last settled copy (empty at page load), stored in a zustand store rather than React state
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps announced keys and open modals stable across a reconnect, and avoids render-phase setState or ref reads (React compiler lint) and render loops with non-memoized mocked selectors (App.test.tsx).

autoDecisions.summary: A 'failed' post-snapshot replay leaves the gate held until the next successful bootstrap
autoDecisions.rationale: replay() calls coordinator.failRecovery(), which defers every later live event, so the store is frozen anyway; settling would only expose questions the missed events may have cleared.

narrative.Action: PRD work item 1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-5604.md), revised after the plan critique. Create lib/agentPendingInputGate.ts: a zustand store useAgentPendingInputGate with `held: PendingAgentInputs | null`, initial NOTHING_SETTLED (module-level empty arrays); holdAgentPendingInput() is a no-op when already held, else captures selectAgentsWithPendingAskUserQuestion/selectAgentsWithPendingProposedPlan(useDashboardStore.getState()); settleAgentPendingInput() sets held null. Exact code is in the PRD. store.ts must not import it. In EventRouter.tsx bootstrap(): call holdAgentPendingInput() right after `if (gen !== generation) return null` and before syncSnapshot(snapshot); replace the replay line with `const replayOutcome = needsReplay ? await replay(snapshot.sequence) : 'caught-up'`, keep the too-far-behind throw, then `if (replayOutcome === 'caught-up' && gen === generation) settleAgentPendingInput()` before `if (reconnecting)`. A 'failed' replay leaves the gate held (D-9). The cache load does not touch the gate; lib/connectionState.ts is not changed. Tests: new agentPendingInputGate.test.ts; EventRouter.test.tsx resets the gate in beforeEach and adds the three named cases plus a held assertion in the existing too-far-behind test. Add the new test file to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.
